rules.name: has_phd
rules.description: Founder holds a PhD or doctorate.
rules.expression: lambda founder: any('phd' in e.get('degree', '').lower() or 'doctor' in e.get('degree', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', []))

rules.name: prior_ipo
rules.description: Founder was involved in a prior IPO.
rules.expression: lambda founder: len(founder.get('ipos', [])) > 0

rules.name: has_mba
rules.description: Founder has an MBA degree.
rules.expression: lambda founder: any('mba' in e.get('degree', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', []))

rules.name: industry_present
rules.description: Founder has work experience in the startup's industry.
rules.expression: lambda founder: any(job.get('industry', '').lower() == founder.get('industry', '').lower() for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

rules.name: industry_experience_years
rules.description: Founder has at least 2 years of experience in the startup's industry.
rules.expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(job.get('duration', '')) >= 2 and job.get('industry', '').lower() == founder.get('industry', '').lower() for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

rules.name: lead_in_industry
rules.description: Founder has held a CEO, President, or Founder role in the industry.
rules.expression: lambda founder: any(job.get('role', '').lower() in ['ceo', 'president', 'founder'] and job.get('industry', '').lower() == founder.get('industry', '').lower() for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

rules.name: education_qs_rank_high
rules.description: Founder attended an institution with QS rank <= 50.
rules.expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 50 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

rules.name: multiple_educations
rules.description: Founder has more than one degree.
rules.expression: lambda founder: len(founder.get('educations', [])) > 1

rules.name: industry_known
rules.description: Founder has experience in a known startup industry (not NaN or empty).
rules.expression: lambda founder: founder.get('industry', '').lower() not in ['nan', '']

rules.name: has_exited
rules.description: Founder has had a prior exit event (IPO or acquisition).
rules.expression: lambda founder: len(founder.get('ipos', [])) > 0 or len(founder.get('acquisitions', [])) > 0

rules.name: experience_in_large_company
rules.description: Founder has worked in a company with more than 1000 employees.
rules.expression: lambda founder: any(parse_company_size(job.get('company_size', '')) >= 1000 for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

rules.name: experience_in_small_company
rules.description: Founder has worked in a company with fewer than 50 employees.
rules.expression: lambda founder: any(parse_company_size(job.get('company_size', '')) < 50 for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

rules.name: industry_diverse_experience
rules.description: Founder has worked in at least 3 different industry sectors.
rules.expression: lambda founder: len(set(job.get('industry', '').lower() for job in founder.get('jobs', []))) >= 3

rules.name: has_education_in_field
rules.description: Founder has education in the startup's field.
rules.expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('field', '').lower() in founder.get('industry', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', []))

rules.name: has_experience_in_startup_roles
rules.description: Founder has held startup roles (co-founder, CEO, CTO).
rules.expression: lambda founder: any(job.get('role', '').lower() in ['co-founder', 'ceo', 'cto'] for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

rules.name: has_multiple_exits
rules.description: Founder has had more than one exit (IPO or acquisition).
rules.expression: lambda founder: len(founder.get('ipos', [])) + len(founder.get('acquisitions', [])) > 1

rules.name: experience_in_high_qs_rank_institution
rules.description: Founder attended an institution with QS rank <= 10.
rules.expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 10 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

rules.name: has_qs_top_10
rules.description: Founder has education from a QS-ranked institution within top 10.
rules.expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 10 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

rules.name: industry_in_tech
rules.description: Founder is in a technology-related industry.
rules.expression: lambda founder: 'software' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'technology' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'internet' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

rules.name: has_executive_experience
rules.description: Founder has held an executive role (e.g., CEO, President).
rules.expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('role', '').lower() in ['ceo', 'president', 'co-founder', 'founder', 'owner', 'executive chairman', 'chief', 'director'] for e in founder.get('jobs', []))

rules.name: education_in_stem
rules.description: Founder has an education degree in a STEM field.
rules.expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('field', '').lower() in ['computer science', 'engineering', 'biomedical engineering', 'materials science', 'mechanical engineering', 'electrical engineering', 'informatics'] for e in founder.get('educations', []))

rules.name: industry_has_ipo
rules.description: Founder has been involved in a startup with an IPO event.
rules.expression: lambda founder: len(founder.get('ipos', [])) > 0

rules.name: has_mba_or_msc
rules.description: Founder has an MBA or MSc degree.
rules.expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('degree', '').lower() in ['mba', 'msc', 'master'] for e in founder.get('educations', []))

rules.name: industry_in_healthcare
rules.description: Founder is in healthcare or medical industries.
rules.expression: lambda founder: 'health' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'medical' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'clinical' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

rules.name: has_phd
rules.description: Founder has a PhD degree.
rules.expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('degree', '').lower() == 'phd' for e in founder.get('educations', []))

rules.name: years_in_job

rules.expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(e.get('duration', '')) >= 9 for e in founder.get('jobs', []))

rules.name: industry_has_acquisitions
rules.description: Founder has been involved in a startup acquisition.
rules.expression: lambda founder: len(founder.get('acquisitions', [])) > 0

rules.name: industry_in_finance
rules.description: Founder is in finance or related sectors.
rules.expression: lambda founder: 'finance' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'financial' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

rules.name: has_bachelors
rules.description: Founder has at least a bachelor’s degree.
rules.expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('degree', '').lower() in ['bsc', 'bachelor', 'ba', 'bfa', 'btech', 'bs'] for e in founder.get('educations', []))

rules.name: industry_in_education
rules.description: Founder is in education or research sectors.
rules.expression: lambda founder: 'education' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'research' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

rules.name: has_multiple_educations

rules.name: industry_has_experience

rules.name: industry_in_legal

rules.expression: lambda founder: 'law' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'legal' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'policy' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

rules.name: has_experience_in_senior_roles

rules.name: has_entrepreneurial_experience

rules.expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(job.get('duration', '')) >= 2 for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

rules.name: company_size_experience

rules.expression: lambda founder: any(parse_company_size(job.get('company_size', '')) >= 50 for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

rules.expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 10 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

rules.name: has_digital_or_tech_education
rules.description: Founder has education in digital or tech-related fields.
rules.expression: lambda founder: any('computer' in e.get('field', '').lower() or 'software' in e.get('field', '').lower() or 'information' in e.get('field', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', []))

rules.name: industry_is_nan_or_missing
rules.description: Industry data is missing or NaN.
rules.expression: lambda founder: founder.get('industry') is None or founder.get('industry') == 'NaN'

rules.name: has_multifield_education
rules.description: Founder has multiple degrees in different fields.
rules.expression: lambda founder: len({e.get('field', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', [])}) > 1
